QuestInfo.name: Their Purpose
QuestInfo.0: #p2152004# contacted you, but she didn't say why.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152004# asked you to investigate the area where you lost #p2151005# to #p2154009#'s trap. It will be difficult, but you might be able to find some clue's to #p2154009#'s true plans if you look through the rubble.
QuestInfo.2: #p2154009# is most certainly experimenting on humans somewhere! How could he do this?! Investigate the Research Diary A.

0.0: Good to see you again, #h0#. I've been thinking about everything that happened and trying to figure out the Black Wings' motivation. #p2154009# presents himself as an ordinary scientist, but he is hiding a dark secret. If only we knew what he hoped to gain by experimenting on humans!
0.1: As for #p2151005#... I hate to sound crass, but I can only be happy that her loss is not one that affects the Resistance. Don't misunderstand, what #p2154009# did to her was unforgivable, but it may finally provide the answers we need.
0.2: I know it will be difficult for you, but I want you to go to the mines again. Investigate the area where #p2154009# installed his trap. Anything he wanted to hide that badly can't have gone wtihout a trace.

yes.0: I know you and #p2151005# were close and I know you must think I'm a monster, but we cannot let her loss be in vain. The Resistance must go on and this could be the chance to take down one of our greatest foes. This could be our opportunity to put #p2154009# down for good!

1.0: Let me see what you've found. There must be something...

item.0: I thought you'd already left. Take your time, I know this is hard.
